seo.title: Cap Malabata Tangier | Eastern Bay Views | MoroccoTripMap
seo.description: Cap Malabata sits east of Tangier with open views back across the bay and toward the Spanish coast — a quieter headland stop.
seo.keywords: Cap Malabata, Cape Malabata Tangier, Tangier bay viewpoint

overview.title: Looking back at the city and the strait
overview.p1: Cap Malabata is the eastern counterpart to Cap Spartel’s western drama. From the headland you look back toward Tangier’s bay, with Spain sometimes visible across the water on clear days.
overview.p2: It is less packaged than the Spartel–caves loop. Come for air and perspective; facilities are limited compared with the city centre.

1.title: Clear bay
1.desc: Often good visibility back toward the city.

2.title: Open headland
2.desc: Short stop for the panorama — limited shade.

3.title: Softer city line
3.desc: Gentler light on the bay if skies stay clear.

food.title: Eat near Malabata
food.p1: Sparse options on the cape — eat in Tangier before or after.
food.li5: Agree taxi wait if you linger.

1.title: Getting there
1.desc: Petit taxi from Tangier; agree a round-trip price including waiting.

2.title: Why go
2.desc: Perspective on the bay rather than a long hiking network.

3.title: Pairing
3.desc: Works as a lighter alternative or addition to the western cape loop.

q1.question: How far from the centre?
q1.answer: A short drive east of Tangier — typically under 30 minutes depending on traffic.

q2.question: Better than Cap Spartel?
q2.answer: Different: Spartel is the classic lighthouse/caves outing; Malabata is quieter bay perspective.

q3.question: Is there a lighthouse to visit?
q3.answer: The interest is the headland views; do not expect a full Spartel-style lighthouse stop.

q4.question: Good in haze?
q4.answer: Long views suffer — prioritise clear days.

q5.question: Family friendly?
q5.answer: Yes for a short viewpoint stop with supervision near edges.
